_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the audio area. Audio and DSP - devices, levels, transmit audio, filters, noise reduction. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
_1_shared: Said in several audio places, word for word the same in each. Changing one of these changes every place that says it.
_2_check: The Audio Check: keying the transmitter to hear how you sound.
audio.check.remote_monitor_advice: Note: over remote, monitor audio arrives delayed. Record and play back is recommended.
audio.check.remote_monitor_note: Over remote, monitor audio arrives delayed; record and play back is recommended.
audio.check.still_transmitting: Still transmitting. Stop the check first.
audio.check.power_reduced_for_check: Power reduced from {watts} watts for the check.
audio.check.dummy_load_released: Dummy load released, power back to {watts} watts.
audio.check.line_dummy_load: Audio check, dummy load, no RF. Keyed on {freq}, audio from {source}.
audio.check.line_transmitting: Audio check, transmitting on {freq} at {watts} {unit}, audio from {source}.
audio.check.recorder_already_running: Recorder was already running; using it.
audio.check.recording_plays_back: Recording; your take plays back when you stop.
audio.check.radio_did_not_key: The radio did not key. Check interlocks and the mic source.
audio.check.buffer_nearly_full: Recording buffer nearly full; oldest audio will drop off.
audio.check.hardware_keying_active: Warning: the radio is still transmitting. Hardware keying is active, source {source}. Software cannot unkey a hardware line; release the hand mic or rear P T T line.
audio.check.playing_take_shortly: Playing your take in a moment.
audio.check.playing_take_full_chain: Playing your take. It carries your full processing chain. Play last take repeats it.
audio.check.no_recording_yet: No recording yet. Run an audio check with record and play back.
_3_loopback: The loopback check: real RF through the transverter port, inside one radio.
audio.check.loopback_no_free_slice: no free slice for the listening receiver
audio.check.loopback_setup_failed: Loopback check could not be set up: {reason}.
audio.check.loopback_ended: Loopback ended. Antenna, power, monitor and duplex settings restored.
audio.check.loopback_line: Loopback check. Transmitting at one watt into the transverter port on {freq}, audio from {source}.
audio.check.loopback_honesty: You will hear your own signal through an overloaded receiver: it proves your audio is present and processed, not exactly how you sound on the air.
audio.check.loopback_drive_reduced: Transverter drive reduced for a cleaner listen.
audio.check.loopback_proves_chain: This also proves your transmitter chain end to end.
_4_preset: Audio chain presets: the Workshop toolbar's load, save, export, import and reset.
audio.preset.reset_to_defaults: Transmit audio settings reset to defaults
audio.preset.export_failed: The file could not be written to {file}. Nothing was exported.
audio.preset.import_unreadable: {file} could not be read as an audio preset. Nothing was imported.
audio.preset.imported: Imported {preset}. Added to your saved presets; the radio is unchanged until you load it.
audio.preset.save_failed_reason: It could not be saved — there is no operator loaded, so there is no place to keep it yet.
audio.preset.deleted_but_not_saved: Preset {preset} removed from the list, but {reason} It will be back next time.
audio.preset.imported_but_not_saved: {preset} was read from the file, but {reason}
audio.preset.delete_body: This deletes {preset} from your saved presets. There is no undo — to get it back you would save or import it again. Nothing on the radio changes.
